description: Record a manual payment against an invoice (cash, bank transfer, cheque, card terminal). Updates invoice status to PARTIAL or PAID based on the running total.

amount.description: Payment amount as decimal string, e.g. "100.00"

invoiceId.description: Invoice ID to record payment against

reference.description: External reference (cheque number, bank transfer ID)

name: record_invoice_payment

data.description: Tool result payload — shape varies per tool, see the tool description

renderType.description: UI rendering hint for the result

summary.description: One-line human-readable summary of the action
